profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Hello! I am currently a software engineer at Google on the Google Domains Search team. I completed my Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science at the University of Massachusetts Amherst. I'm primarily focused on distributed systems and backend technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Azure Compute Organization | Azure Automation team

Working on the Azure Update Management UX features and bugs. This product was GA'd on March 2018.

Implemented the Update Management - Dynamic Groups UX, which was demoed at the Microsoft Ignite 2018 Conference

Working on features and bugs for the Azure Update Management package installation runbook for Linux VMs.

Working on the Scheduler UX and Scheduler backend for Azure Automation Accounts and Runbooks.

Working for oncall rotation for immediate team and Azure Automation team.

positions.title: CMPSCI 377 - Operating Systems Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Responsible for grading exams  and homework for the operating systems class.

positions.title: CMPSCI 520/620 - Advanced Software Engineering Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Responsible for meeting with the Professor to plan homework and project assignments for students in the "Advanced Software Engineering" class. 

Responsible for grading exams, projects, and homework as well as giving in-class exercises.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Cloud & Enterprise Division - Powershell Tools

Worked under the PowerShell team to create an auto-generated UI for PowerShell modules. 

Developed and designed the application using Angular 2, Express, BootStrap, and Microsoft MWF to create a cross-platform interface for module-element generation.

positions.title: CMPSCI 220 - Programming Methodology Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
Responsible for grading projects and giving high-quality feedback in the precursor to the
Software Engineering course offered. Projects are written in Scala.

 Held office hours, ran discussion periods, and provided help to students.

honors.title: Academic Dean's List
honors.description: Achieved a GPA of 3.5 or above for all semesters.

honors.title: 1st Place HackHolyoke 2015
honors.description: Recipient of HackHolyoke 2015 award for mobile application "Hello World" that allows for automatic translation between languages to break communication barriers between people. Currently the app only supports translation of English to over 100 other languages, but will be able to translate from other languages in the future. We also used Indico's Machine Learning algorithms for sentimentality detection.

projects.title: Saveyour
projects.description: Developed original idea and lead team to develop Saveyour - a productivity and organization application catered towards college students and busy individuals that serves as an electronic agenda. I developed the core functionality and design of the application and strived for modularity as well as extendability. Written in C#.

projects.title: TEDxAmherst Android/iOS App
projects.description: Responsible for development of TEDxAmherst Mobile App developed using Ionic and Cordova. Tweaked speakers/schedule tabs and detailed layout of app. Currently in process of Google Maps integration and adding push notifcations.
